final_topology.title: Azure Hub-Spoke Network
final_topology.description: A hub-and-spoke Azure network with centralized security and management.
final_topology.topology_summary: The hub contains an Azure Firewall and Azure Bastion. Spokes are VNETs for identity, operations, and workloads, with all inter-spoke traffic routed through the hub firewall.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Inventory System' (n_new1) in the 'Asset Management' zone (z_new1) that manages inventory for various nodes and zones.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Data Flow Documentation System' (n_new2) in the 'Data Flow Documentation' zone (z_new2) that manages data flow documentation for various nodes and zones.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple VNETs (Identity VNet, Operations VNet, Workload VNet) that are segmented and routed through the central 'Hub VNet' (z1) with an Azure Firewall (n1).

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Azure Firewall' (n1) in the 'Hub VNet' (z1) that manages traffic between different VNETs.

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Server' (n7) in the 'Hub VNet' (z1) that is used by various nodes and zones.

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'MFA Server' (n9) in the 'Hub VNet' (z1) that is integrated with the 'Remote Access' zone (z_new3) and 'Azure Bastion' (n2).

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Filtering Service' (n_new3) in the 'Hub VNet' (z1) that is connected to the 'DNS Server' (n7).

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Web Proxy' (n8) in the 'Hub VNet' (z1) that is connected to the 'Log Analytics Workspace' (n3) for monitoring and enforcing URL filters.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes a hub-and-spoke design with a central 'Hub VNet' (z1) and multiple VNETs (Identity VNet, Operations VNet, Workload VNet) that are segmented and managed securely.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'IaC Management' (n_new4) and 'Secure Protocols' (n_new5) in the 'Hub VNet' (z1) that manage infrastructure as code and secure protocols for various nodes and zones.

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'AAA Server' (n10) in the 'Hub VNet' (z1) that is integrated with various nodes and zones for centralized AAA.

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'VPN Service' (n_new6) in the 'Remote Access' zone (z_new3) that is integrated with the 'AAA Server' (n10) and 'Azure Bastion' (n2).

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Dedicated Computing Resources for All Administrative Work
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Admin Workstation' (n11) in the 'Management VNet' (z5) that is segmented from other networks and does not have internet access.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'NIDS' (n12) in the 'Hub VNet' (z1) that is connected to the 'Log Analytics Workspace' (n3) for monitoring and alerting.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes 'NSG - Identity VNet' (n4), 'NSG - Operations VNet' (n5), and 'NSG - Workload VNet' (n6) that perform traffic filtering between different VNETs.

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Access Control Policy' (n_new7) in the 'Remote Access' zone (z_new3) that is integrated with the 'Azure Bastion' (n2) and 'MFA Server' (n9).

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple links (nl1, nl2, nl3, nl4) that collect traffic logs from various nodes and send them to the 'Log Analytics Workspace' (n3).

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Prevention Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'NIPS' (n13) in the 'Hub VNet' (z1) that is connected to the 'Log Analytics Workspace' (n3) for monitoring and alerting.

controls.title: Deploy Port-Level Access Control
controls.evidence: The topology includes an '802.1X Controller' (n14) in the 'Hub VNet' (z1) that is connected to the 'Log Analytics Workspace' (n3) for managing port-level access control.

controls.title: Perform Application Layer Filtering
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Application Firewall' (n15) in the 'Hub VNet' (z1) that is connected to the 'Log Analytics Workspace' (n3) for performing application layer filtering.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Non-Production VNet' (z_preserve1) that is separate from the production VNETs (Identity VNet, Operations VNet, Workload VNet).

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Penetration Testing Service' (n_new8) in the 'External Testing VNet' (z6) that is connected to various nodes and zones for conducting penetration tests.

findings_before.title: empty_zone_without_node
findings_before.missing_reason: Zone z6 has no concrete node assigned to it.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add one representative concrete node in this zone and connect it with node_links to the nearest hub, firewall, router, or management/security node.

findings_before.title: ig3_missing_ig2_zone_semantics
findings_before.missing_reason: IG3 topology removed or failed to preserve IG2 zone semantics.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add the missing IG2 zone semantics to IG3 as preserved or stricter zones, with representative nodes and concrete node_links. IG3 may add controls but must not reduce segmentation.

findings_before.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
findings_before.evidence: The topology does not explicitly show an asset inventory system or process. However, the presence of various nodes and zones suggests that an inventory might exist.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of an asset inventory system or process.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing an asset inventory system and links to all other nodes.

findings_before.title: Document Data Flows
findings_before.evidence: The topology shows various links and zones, but there is no explicit documentation of data flows.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of documented data flows.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a data flow documentation system and links to relevant nodes and zones.

findings_before.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes a DNS Server (n7) but does not explicitly show DNS filtering services.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of DNS filtering services.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a DNS filtering service and links to relevant nodes.

findings_before.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes various security nodes (firewall, bastion, MFA, etc.) but does not explicitly show secure management practices like IaC or secure protocols.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of secure management practices.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add nodes representing IaC and secure protocols and links to relevant nodes.

findings_before.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes an Azure Bastion (n2) but does not explicitly show a VPN or remote device connections.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of a VPN or remote device connections.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a VPN and links to remote devices and the AAA infrastructure.

findings_before.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes an Azure Bastion (n2) and an MFA Server (n9) but does not explicitly show access control for remote assets.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of access control for remote assets.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add nodes representing access control policies and links to remote assets.

findings_before.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes an External Testing VNet (z6) but does not explicitly show penetration testing processes.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of periodic external penetration tests.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a penetration testing service and links to relevant nodes.
